payload.detail: DIAGNOSIS DISPROVEN BY LIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-09-20. This row says every catalogue search reads the whole release payload because the kind filter cannot reach the scan beneath the left join to site_content_publications. Migration 20260916103000_push_kind_filter_into_site_content_public_records fixed that, and production now confirms the filter reaches the scan: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) gives kind=service 227 rows in 21.4 ms and kind=medication 330 rows in 22.2 ms - that kind's rows only, not all 843, in milliseconds not seconds. The row's own next action was 're-measure first; the digest removal may have changed the plan'. It did. What remains is a DIFFERENT defect with the same symptom, raised separately: the read returns render_payload for every row, 56-64 percent of the bytes, and nothing on the read path consumes it. Do not carry the disproven cause forward - its remedy sends someone to fix a join that is already correct.
